title: UPSC Civil Services Preliminary Examination — Previous Year Questions (PYQ) Master Archive

subjects.name: Indian Polity & Governance
subjects.examinerPattern: Heavy emphasis on conceptual nuances (constitutional limits, arbitrary power), Article 19/21 application, and parliamentary control mechanisms.

subjects.name: Economy & Social Development
subjects.examinerPattern: Questions test direct macroeconomic causality (e.g., sterilization of foreign inflows, money multiplier, yield curve inversion) and real vs. nominal distinctions.

subjects.name: Environment, Ecology & Biodiversity
subjects.examinerPattern: Geographic positioning of National Parks/Rivers, invasive species indicators, and micro-pollutants (microplastics, PFAS, hydrofluorocarbons).

subjects.name: History of India & National Movement
subjects.examinerPattern: Terminology matching (e.g. Eripatti, Taniyurs), chronological ordering of 20th-century events, and doctrinal differences in ancient traditions.

subjects.name: Indian & World Geography
subjects.examinerPattern: Spatial relation questions (locations bordering Mediterranean/Black Sea), river tributaries from origin to confluence, and major agricultural production shifts.

subjects.name: Science & Emerging Technology
subjects.examinerPattern: Application-oriented questions asking 'In how many of the above can this technology be applied?' and differentiating emerging frontier tech.
